restaurant_name: The Smile Bar Bangkok - Teeth Whitening Bangkok
text:
I visited The Smile Bar for a same-day whitening package, which included three back-to-back whitening treatments, as well as a teeth cleaning. Overall, the treatment itself was good. I also received a protective treatment to help prevent tooth sensitivity for up to 30 days; however, this was not complimentary and was charged separately, as everything was an additional cost.

While the results were satisfactory, several aspects of the experience were disappointing. The staff member assisting me appeared disengaged and was frequently on her phone, which felt unprofessional during a dental procedure.

There was also a hygiene concern. There was only one sink available for all patients to rinse their mouths. During the two hours I was there, I did not see the sink area cleaned even once between patients. When I went to rinse, there was visible residue from previous patients, including saliva and debris, which was unpleasant and raised concerns about cleanliness.

Pricing transparency was another issue. The charges for the teeth cleaning were not clearly explained beforehand, and I was also charged an additional 300 THB service fee that was never mentioned in advance.

One additional point for future customers: I noticed that some five-star reviews appear to be incentivized. Customers are offered a free wooden toothbrush in exchange for leaving a five-star review. For this reason, I would recommend doing your own research and not relying solely on the ratings.

There are other dental clinics available, such as All About Teeth, that offer whitening services and, in my experience, can provide even whiter results. I suggest comparing options before deciding.

Overall, while the treatment itself was acceptable, improvements in staff professionalism, hygiene practices, and transparency around pricing would greatly improve the experience.
